CC-2237 |homeworld=[[Kamino]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}}{{Film|III}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Databank|clone-pilot-odd-ball|Clone Pilot Odd Ball}} |pronouns=He/him |donor=[[Jango Fett]]{{Databank|clone-troopers|Clone Troopers}} |height=1.83 [[meter]]s {{C|6[[Foot|ft]]}} |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Clone Flight Squad Seven]]{{SWE|technology|arc170starfighter|ARC-170 starfighter}} *[[Galactic Empire]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|45|Helmets}} **Clone Flight Squad Seven |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|We're on your tail, General Kenobi.|Davijaan, during the Battle of Coruscant|}} '''Davijaan''', designated '''CC-2237''' and also known by the [[callsign]] "'''Odd Ball'''," was a [[Clone Commander]] and [[Clone trooper pilot|pilot]] during the [[Clone Wars]] who participated in campaigns such as the [[Battle of Teth]], the [[Battle of Umbara]], the [[Battle of Coruscant]], and the [[Battle of Utapau]]. A skilled [[pilot]], Odd Ball flew an assortment of various [[starfighter]]s including a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]], a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]] and an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter|ARC-170]]. During the Clone Wars, Odd Ball often served under the command of [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== The [[clone trooper]] CC-2237,''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' who eventually took on the name Davijaan,{{BuildFalconCite|36|Starship Fact File}} was a [[human]] [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] created on [[Kamino]]. He also received the code name "Odd Ball,"''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' which further served as his [[callsign]].[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] Used as if it was his name, "Odd Ball" became a common way to refer to the [[clone trooper pilot]].{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}} While on Kamino, Odd Ball received early training as part of the [[pilot]] program. ===The Clone Wars=== ====The early days==== {{Quote|Thank you, sir. Sorry I panicked.''"
"''That's all right, Odd Ball. It happens to everybody.|Odd Ball and Obi-Wan Kenobi, during the Battle of Teth|audio=OddBallPanicked-TCWf.flac|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]}} With the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]] following the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], Odd Ball, now a [[Clone Commander]] and leader of [[Clone Flight Squad Seven]], was sent to a [[Coruscant flight academy|flight academy]] on the Republic capital [[planet]] of [[Coruscant]] for additional training. There, Odd Ball learned new tactics and tricks, which he passed down to the pilots under his command. As the [[squadron commander]] of Squad Seven, Odd Ball fell under the leadership of [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and under the structure of his [[Open Circle Fleet|Open Circle Armada]]. [[File:OddBallV19Torrent-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Odd Ball during the Battle of Teth]] During the Republic's attempt to rescue [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt's]] kidnapped [[Rotta|son]], Odd Ball was called in to assist the [[troop]]s who were fighting [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] [[Confederacy military|forces]] during the [[Battle of Teth]]. Flying in a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]], he and Squad Seven fought oncoming [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] alongside Kenobi. During the battle, Odd Ball was tailed by vulture droids and remarked that he was unable to shake them. [[General]] Kenobi came to the pilot's aid and destroyed the droids, saving Odd Ball. The clone pilot apologized for panicking, and Kenobi assured him that it happened to everybody. ====Battle of Umbara==== [[File:OddballCC2237-SWZ.png|thumb|right|250px|CC-2237 and a wingman conduct a bombing run during the Battle of Umbara.]] {{Quote|Good old Odd Ball. Always on target.|[[Jesse]]|}} At the start of the [[Battle of Umbara]], Odd Ball participated alongside the rest of Squad Seven, and he and another bomber were called in to provide reinforcements. They bombed a vulnerable enemy position moments after the last of the clone forces evacuated the area. ====Battle of Cato Neimoidia==== [[File:OddBall-CC2237-SWZ.png|thumb|left|220px|"Odd Ball" on Cato Neimoidia with Plo Koon]] Odd Ball was present on [[Cato Neimoidia]], escorting [[Jedi]] General [[Plo Koon]] in the [[atmosphere]].{{FFGXW2|set=ARC-170 Starfighter Expansion Pack|cardname="Odd Ball"}} His unit, Clone Flight Squad Seven, participated in the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]].{{FFGXW2|set=ARC-170 Starfighter Expansion Pack|cardname=Squad Seven Veteran}} ====Battle of Coruscant==== {{Quote|Clone Flight Squad Seven launched from the carrier ''Ro-Ti-Mundi''. Our mission was to escort Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to the Separatist flagship ''Invisible Hand'' and cover them while they executed a boarding action.|Odd Ball's account of the Battle of Coruscant|}} [[File:OddBallARC170-SWM.png|thumb|right|250px|Odd Ball during the Battle of Coruscant]] Odd Ball participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant]], leading Clone Flight Squad Seven to the ''[[Invisible Hand]]'' for Kenobi and [[Anakin Skywalker]]. He ordered the squad's V-19 Torrent [[starfighter]]s to take point. This group of fighters punched a hole through the [[droid tri-fighter]]s. This allowed the Jedi and the [[squad]]'s [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter|ARC-170 starfighters]] to move towards the ''Invisible Hand''. When the Jedi landed in the ship's [[hangar]], the squad eliminated priority targets and stayed close in case they were needed for aid. He did not expect the Jedi to survive. ====Battle of Utapau==== When it was discovered that the leader of the [[Separatist Droid Army]], General [[Grievous]], was hiding on the planet of [[Utapau]], Kenobi and the [[212th Attack Battalion]] were sent. Clone troopers engaged [[battle droid]]s in a heated confrontation, whilst Kenobi had his final confrontation with Grievous, resulting in the [[cyborg]]'s death. Later, however, [[Order 66]] was issued by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. As the contingency was issued, Odd Ball was in battle above Utapau as part of [[Obi-Wan's fleet]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|41|Databank A-Z}} Odd Ball and the rest of Squad Seven on Utapau turned on the [[Utapau Skyforce]] and subjugated the planet. He then coordinated the rest of Squad Seven in an effort to hunt down Kenobi, as his body was not found after his reported death, coordinating ships to search the area around [[Pau City]]. Odd Ball and his unit later served the [[Galactic Empire]]. ==Personality and traits== A human male clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett, CC-2237 was 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s. He proved to be a skilled pilot during the Clone Wars and was apologetic towards Obi-Wan Kenobi when the Jedi provided assistance at the Battle of Teth. ==Skills and abilities== As a veteran clone pilot, Odd Ball was an expert at starfighter, and starship piloting, as well as military tactics. ==Equipment== Initially during the Clone Wars, Odd Ball donned standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor|Phase I armor]] for all clone trooper pilots. Later in the war, he switched to the [[Phase II clone trooper armor|Phase II]] variant which featured a fully enclosed helmet and breathing apparatus. Still later in the war, he adopted the newer open-helmet design, which he wore during the Battle of Coruscant. [[File:OddBall.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Davijaan's helmet during the Battle of Coruscant]] During the Battle of Coruscant, Davijaan wore the newer design of helmet that was primarily white in color with a black stripe down its center and three curved yellow markings crossed by a black symbol directly above the helmet's visor on the right side of Odd Ball's head. A yellow pattern also ran along the top of the two circular sides of the helmet. On a separate occasion, Odd Ball wore a helmet of the same make with differing coloring, still being primarily white but having a red stripe with a smaller yellow stripe inside it down the center with two thinner lines curving down the back of the helmet and then around under each cheek. The circular sides of the helmet each had three red stripes on top and a red symbol on the side. Another clone wore a helmet with this patterning during the Battle of Coruscant but perished. ==Behind the scenes== CC-2237 was portrayed by [[Temuera Morrison]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. He also appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]], in which he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. In [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 45|''Star Wars Helmet Collection'' 45]], predominantly in the first half of the magazine, Odd Ball is first referred to as a Clone Commander. In the second half of the magazine, the rank changes to [[Clone Captain]]. Because [[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']] also refers to him as a Clone Commander, this article assumes that the rank of Clone Captain is erroneous. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Davijaan|imagecat=Images of Davijaan}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] *{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}} {{C|Starfighter only}} *{{StoryCite|story=The Shadow of Umbara|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark|audiobook=1}} {{C|Starfighter only}} *{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}} *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|technology|arc170starfighter|ARC-170 starfighter}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|41|Databank A-Z}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *''[[Star Wars Trivia Game]]'' *{{BuildFalconCite|36|Starship Fact File}} {{1stID|Davijaan}} {{SourceContents|issue={{HelmetCollectionCite|45|parent=1}}|contents= *{{HelmetCollectionCite|45|Helmets}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|45|Highlights of the Saga}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|45|Weapons & Uniforms}} }} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' {{1stID|CC-2237}} *{{BuildXWingCite|16|Starfighter Aces}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] *{{FFGXW2|set=ARC-170 Starfighter Expansion Pack|cardname="Odd Ball"}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Guardians of the Republic Squadron Pack|cardname="Odd Ball"}} *{{FFGXW2|set=BTL-B Y-Wing Expansion Pack|cardname="Odd Ball"}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic, Rebel, and Resistance Starfighters}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Nimbus-class V-Wing Expansion Pack|cardname="Odd Ball"}} *{{Armada|set=Republic Fighter Squadrons Expansion Pack|cardname="Odd Ball"}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia -
